header.name: OROS-V7 · SYLLABARY
header.description: Harmonic-physics world: 108Hz Hum, 60 BPM / 16-pulse lattice, Echo-Grip 14.22, light 192,000 Phon/s. 4 departments × 4 Mythos × 16 entries. Artist: Vril-Hap-Res.

payload.description: Rectangular plateaus set by the lattice tempo
Grey silt where sound goes to die
Rock faces replaying passers 16 cycles ago
Mountains shifting with the observer's Hum
Plains reflecting neither light nor sound
Winds playing the land like a flute
Mist blurring the order of events
Singing a seed into a room
A mountain's shadow flipped into a home
Moving as another did 16 pulses ago
Height set by nearness to the Hum
All entities sync to one pitch
All sound returns to the Hum
Knots stop erasure of the past
Tempo slip reverts all to stacking
Forests grow a metre per 16 pulses
Tying an item to its owner
